
== Japanese Hoth printing ==
The collecting encyclopedia, p. 103, index 4374, lists this Dark Side, black-border, nonfoil Vehicle publication and rarity; p. 43 dates the Japanese Limited edition to September 1998. <ref name="encyclopedia-172-hoth">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> The English catalog name and original-state printing ID <code>1303_156o</code> follow the approved identity mapping. The source index is not the printing ID. The catalog list does not supply those face details. No native-title alias or GEMP implementation claim is made. The retained preserved PDF has a verified source-matching SHA256.
